summary: Procure Deepnote Enterprise pilot (VPC tenant) with SCIM/Okta SSO and BYOK for Research notebooks
description:
Issue summary:
Request procurement and onboarding for a Deepnote Enterprise pilot for the Research & Applied ML org. We need a single-tenant VPC-hosted deployment (private instance), SCIM group sync provisioning from Okta, SAML/Okta SSO, and BYOK support for notebook storage encryption.

Background & rationale:
- Research team needs a managed collaborative notebook environment that supports large data attachments, workspace templates, and access controls.
- Deepnote offers a VPC/private tenancy option compatible with our network security requirements and a SCIM/Okta integration we prefer for lifecycle management.
- This is a pilot (40 full-time seats + 10 contractor burst seats for 90 days). If successful, will scale to ~150 seats in Q4.

Requested deliverables:
- Procurement (PO) for a 12-month pilot license with 90-day trial billing milestone.
- Vendor security documentation (SOC 2 Type II report, penetration test summary, data processing addendum, HIPAA attestation if available).
- SSO (SAML) metadata exchange and SCIM group mappings.
- VPC peering setup guide and IP ranges.
- BYOK/KMS integration options (preferred: customer-managed key in AWS KMS or HSM).

Notes on urgency:
- Request by 2026-03-25 to align with research sprint start on 2026-04-01.
impact: Medium: Affects Research & Applied ML productivity and ability to run collaborative notebooks for experiments. Not customer-facing, but delays slow several Q2 evaluation milestones.
justification: Consolidate ephemeral notebooks onto a managed, auditable platform to reduce ad-hoc SSH-and-Jupyter setups. Improves reproducibility and reduces telemetry leakage risk. Expected productivity gains for 12 ML engineers and 6 research scientists during pilot.
requested_items: 40 full seats (employees), 10 contractor burst seats (90-day window)
SCIM provisioning + Okta SAML SSO setup
Onboarding support (1 day) and admin training session
cost_estimate: $18,000 - $25,000 USD (annual list estimate from vendor email; final pricing to be confirmed via procurement)
steps_to_onboard: 1) Procurement: create PO and route to vendor (Finance & Legal sign-off)
2) Security: vet SOC2 & pen test; confirm DPA and data flows
3) Infra: coordinate VPC peering details (CIDR, allowed ports, egress rules and NAT), schedule maintenance window if required
4) SSO: exchange SAML metadata with Okta team; configure SCIM group mappings and test provisioning for a pilot group
5) KMS: validate BYOK key policy and access path for Deepnote-managed storage or bring-your-own-key workflow
6) Onboarding: schedule admin training with vendor; invite pilot users and run smoke tests
comments: 2026-03-10 09:12 - Aisha Patel: Initiating request on behalf of Research. Attached vendor quote and architecture note in Confluence. Asked procurement to start PO flow.
2026-03-11 14:28 - Jamal Reed (Security): Uploaded initial vendor security questionnaire. Requesting SOC2 Type II and DPA. Also asking for details on data residency for notebook attachments.

2026-03-11 16:02 - Priya Sharma (SSO): Okta team can provide SCIM group mappings. Need vendor SCIM endpoint, service account details, and whether they support incremental sync. SAML metadata should be exchanged after PO and legal sign-off.
2026-03-12 10:45 - Lena Cho (Procurement): I will raise a PO draft today. Finance flagged need for final vendor W-9 and bank details. Can Aisha provide the vendor contact for invoices?

2026-03-12 15:03 - Noah Kim (Infra): Quick network note - vendor requests outbound access to S3 endpoints in us-east-1 and a peered VPC with specific routes. Will prepare a temporary peering template and CIDR allowance list.

2026-03-13 11:20 - Legal (contract-review): Please prepare vendor DPA and note our requirement for customer-controlled KMS where available. If Deepnote cannot provide BYOK for all storage tiers, include a carve-out in the SOW.
investigation_notes: Vendor interaction summary: Sales rep (deepnote-sales@deepnote.com) confirmed a private tenant option and provided baseline pricing for 50 seats. Trial paperwork available for 90 days.
Security review: initial PQ completed; awaiting SOC2 Type II report and latest penetration test. Vendor claims HIPAA-ready configuration with required BAAs.
SSO/SCIM: vendor supports Okta SCIM v2 and SAML 2.0. They provide a service account model for provisioning; need to test group filters to avoid over-provisioning contractors.
Infra constraints: VPC peering requires static routes and explicit egress to vendor-managed NAT. Scheduled deeper network review after PO.
Risk notes: If BYOK is partial (only at rest but not ephemeral compute), legal needs to sign off on handling of transient data in compute nodes.
resolution_notes: 2026-03-13 - Procurement: PO draft created (PO-108762). Waiting vendor W-9 and bank routing. Action owners: Aisha to provide vendor billing contact; Jamal to confirm SOC2 arrival; Priya to schedule Okta test window for 2026-03-24.
Next steps: finalize PO and DPA, complete security review, perform SAML/SCIM smoke test, then schedule onboarding session with pilot users on 2026-03-29.
